Grayline Highwater audio credits

Highwater's recorded and designed sound effects were trimmed, mixed, and
encoded from the following CC0 1.0 sounds.
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Grass, rocky road, and stone footsteps from TDC FOOTSTEPS, edited by
Standard of Iron.
https://github.com/djeada/Standard-of-Iron/blob/main/docs/AUDIO_LICENSES.md

Hard Footstep 1 and 4 and Step 4 by OwlishMedia.
https://opengameart.org/content/sound-effects-pack

Key Lock Door sounds by OwlishMedia, used for doors, containers, and reloads.
https://opengameart.org/content/202-more-sound-effects

Cloth, Cloth Heavy, and Metal Small sounds by artisticdude.
https://opengameart.org/content/rpg-sound-pack

Dirt/gravel footstep 1 by Yoyodaman234.
https://freesound.org/people/Yoyodaman234/sounds/166511/

wood_10a_startassneakers_walk.wav by sturmankin.
https://freesound.org/people/sturmankin/sounds/273374/

Footstep Metal 1 by GiocoSound.
https://freesound.org/people/GiocoSound/sounds/421134/

Footsteps in a water puddle by launemax.
https://freesound.org/people/launemax/sounds/249911/

Pistol Shot by LeMudCrab.
https://freesound.org/people/LeMudCrab/sounds/163456/

Gun_Shot_86 by SignatureSoundsOrg.
https://freesound.org/people/SignatureSoundsOrg/sounds/876005/

Shotgun 001 - Single shot by pgi.
https://freesound.org/people/pgi/sounds/257963/
